description: Wind & Tide forecast data for Carnival Forecasts. Customer-facing dashboard. No observation data.

panels.description: Wind speed forecast with predicted wind direction on the right y-axis.

targets.rawSql:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS "time",
    windspdmean,
    windspdlb,
    windspdub,
    winddirmean
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE
    windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = 'grp_carnival'
    AND model = '$wind_model'
    AND '$wind_model' <> 'wind_nbm'
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    forecastdtutc AS "time",
    windspdmean AS windspdmean,
    windspdlb AS windspdlb,
    windspdub AS windspdub,
    winddirmean AS winddirmean
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE
    windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = 'grp_carnival'
    AND model = '$wind_model'
    AND '$wind_model' = 'wind_nbm'
    AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
    AND startdt = (
      SELECT MAX(startdt)
      FROM forecast_data
      WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
        AND locname = '$location'
        AND group_id = 'grp_carnival'
        AND model = '$wind_model'
        AND height_m = ${height_m:raw}
        AND windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    )
)
SELECT
  src."time",
  src.windspdmean,
  src.windspdlb,
  src.windspdub,
  w.v1_s0 AS winddirmean,
  w.v1_sm1 AS winddirmean_sm1,
  w.v1_sp1 AS winddirmean_sp1,
  (MOD(MOD(src.winddirmean::numeric, 360) + 360, 360))::float AS winddir_tooltip
FROM src
JOIN public.fn_wrap_directions(
  (SELECT array_agg("time" ORDER BY "time") FROM src),
  (SELECT array_agg(winddirmean ORDER BY "time") FROM src)
) w USING ("time")
ORDER BY src."time"

panels.title: Wind Forecast - UTC (${height_m} m)

panels.description: UTC and forecast-location local time for the latest current-condition wind sample shown in the hero stat panels.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS ts
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = 'grp_carnival'
    AND model = '$wind_model'
    AND (height_m IN (20, 60) OR height_m IS NULL)
    AND timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC, startdt DESC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN height_m = 20 OR height_m IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  to_char(ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI "UTC"')
  || ' | '
  || to_char(ts AT TIME ZONE '$location_tz', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI "Local"') AS "Current Time"
FROM latest

SELECT
  windspdmean
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_carnival'
  AND model = '$wind_model'
  AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 20))
  AND timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
ORDER BY timestamp DESC, startdt DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  (MOD(MOD(winddirmean::numeric, 360) + 360, 360))::float AS winddirmean
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_carnival'
  AND model = '$wind_model'
  AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 20))
  AND timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
ORDER BY timestamp DESC, startdt DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  windspdub
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  windspdmean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_carnival'
  AND model = '$wind_model'
  AND (height_m = ${height_m:raw} OR (height_m IS NULL AND ${height_m:raw} = 20))
  AND timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
ORDER BY timestamp DESC, startdt DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

panels.description: Probability of Thunder in the next 6 hours.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_run AS (
  SELECT MAX(startdt) AS startdt
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE startdt <= NOW()::timestamptz
    AND pot IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = 'grp_carnival'
    AND model = '$wind_model'
)
SELECT
  pot
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  pot IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_carnival'
  AND model = '$wind_model'
  AND startdt = (SELECT startdt FROM selected_run)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  locname AS "Location",
  COALESCE(height_m, 20) AS "Height (m)",
  timestamp AS "Last Updated",
  windspdmean AS "Wind Speed"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (locname, COALESCE(height_m, 20))
    locname,
    height_m,
    timestamp,
    windspdmean
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE windspdmean IS NOT NULL
    AND group_id = 'grp_carnival'
    AND model = '$wind_model'
    AND timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  ORDER BY locname, COALESCE(height_m, 20), timestamp DESC, startdt DESC NULLS LAST
) sub
ORDER BY locname, "Height (m)"

panels.title: Wind Speed by Location and Height

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS "time",
  tidemean,
  tidelb,
  tideub
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  tidemean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_carnival'
  AND model = '$tide_model'
  AND '$tide_model' NOT IN ('tide_nbm', 'tide_blend')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  forecastdtutc AS "time",
  tidemean,
  tidelb,
  tideub
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  tidemean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_carnival'
  AND model = '$tide_model'
  AND '$tide_model' IN ('tide_nbm', 'tide_blend')
  AND startdt = (
    SELECT MAX(startdt)
    FROM forecast_data
    WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
      AND locname = '$location'
      AND group_id = 'grp_carnival'
      AND model = '$tide_model'
  )
ORDER BY "time"

WITH nearest_points AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp,
    tidemean,
    LEAD(timestamp) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS next_timestamp,
    LEAD(tidemean) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS next_tidemean
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE
    tidemean IS NOT NULL
    AND locname = '$location'
    AND group_id = 'grp_carnival'
    AND model = '$tide_model'
  ORDER BY timestamp
)
SELECT
  NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ AS "time",
  CASE
    WHEN next_timestamp IS NULL THEN tidemean
    WHEN NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ >= next_timestamp THEN next_tidemean
    ELSE tidemean + (next_tidemean - tidemean) * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ - timestamp)) / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (next_timestamp - timestamp)), 0)
  END AS tidemean
FROM nearest_points
WHERE timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH nearest_points AS (
  SELECT
    locname,
    datum,
    timestamp,
    tidemean,
    LEAD(timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY locname ORDER BY timestamp) AS next_timestamp,
    LEAD(tidemean) OVER (PARTITION BY locname ORDER BY timestamp) AS next_tidemean
  FROM forecast_data
  WHERE
    tidemean IS NOT NULL
    AND group_id = 'grp_carnival'
    AND model = '$tide_model'
), interpolated AS (
  SELECT
    locname AS "Location",
    NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ AS "Current Time",
    CASE
      WHEN next_timestamp IS NULL THEN tidemean
      WHEN NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ >= next_timestamp THEN next_tidemean
      ELSE tidemean + (next_tidemean - tidemean) * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ - timestamp)) / NULLIF(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (next_timestamp - timestamp)), 0)
    END AS "Predicted Value",
    datum AS "Datum",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY locname ORDER BY timestamp DESC) AS row_num
  FROM nearest_points
  WHERE timestamp <= NOW()::TIMESTAMPTZ
)
SELECT
  "Location",
  "Current Time",
  "Predicted Value",
  "Datum"
FROM interpolated
WHERE row_num = 1
ORDER BY "Location"

SELECT
  timestamp AS "Date (${__timezone})",
  tidemean AS "Predicted Value",
  tideub AS "Tide Upper Bound",
  tidelb AS "Tide Lower Bound"
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  tidemean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_carnival'
  AND model = '$tide_model'
  AND '$tide_model' NOT IN ('tide_nbm', 'tide_blend')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  forecastdtutc AS "Date (${__timezone})",
  tidemean AS "Predicted Value",
  tideub AS "Tide Upper Bound",
  tidelb AS "Tide Lower Bound"
FROM forecast_data
WHERE
  tidemean IS NOT NULL
  AND locname = '$location'
  AND group_id = 'grp_carnival'
  AND model = '$tide_model'
  AND '$tide_model' IN ('tide_nbm', 'tide_blend')
  AND startdt = (
    SELECT MAX(startdt)
    FROM forecast_data
    WHERE startdt <= $__timeFrom()
      AND locname = '$location'
      AND group_id = 'grp_carnival'
      AND model = '$tide_model'
  )
ORDER BY 1
